lead.why: Abstract: 'Compounds 21, 53 and 60 showed broad spectrum antitumor activity with average IC50 values of 6.7, 7.6 and 9.1 uM'; 21 has the lowest average IC50 and Conclusion lists it first as the most active (Fig. 10: 'most active antitumors 21 and 53').

reactions.conditions: 5-nitroanthranilic acid (0.005 mol), 4-methoxyphenyl isothiocyanate (0.005 mol), TEA (2 mL), EtOH (50 mL), reflux 4 h, then rt 12 h; 65%
MeI (3 mL), anhydrous K2CO3 (1 g), acetone (50 mL), rt 8 h; 77%
SnCl2.2H2O (5 equiv), acetone, reflux 2 h; pH 8 with 5% NaHCO3; 63%

notes: Lead choice: abstract also names 29/33 (best DHFR inhibitors) and 53 and 60, but 21 is listed first and has the lowest average antitumor IC50, so rule 1 was applied to 21. 4-Methoxyphenyl isothiocyanate (15) has no printed name (the paper says 'the appropriate substituted phenylisothiocyanate'); structure derived from the name of 17. 'Starting materials and reagents were purchased from [suppliers]' is the only commercial statement. The 2-mercapto compound is drawn as the thiol tautomer as named in the paper (thione tautomer likely in reality).
